_readme: Every number is an input with a basis tag. public_source = cited fact; handoff_assumed = carried from the PR #286 handoff unchanged; assumed = this PR's placeholder to be replaced by a measurement; observed_listing = an asking price seen in market_comps (NOT a realized price). Nothing here is a quote from a supplier.

scrap_lot_buy_all.description: Handoff scenario: five retired low-spec desktops bought as a lot without per-unit inspection, resale NT$2,200 each.

basis.resale_twd: handoff_assumed (market_comps: old i5-6500 8G/256G asks ~2,000 with 0 sold; old gaming PCs ~1,900 with 6 sold)

scrap_lot_inspect_each.description: Same machines, but the supplier lets you inspect and power each unit before you pay (failures are not bought).

basis.policy: requires the supplier to agree; unconfirmed

business_8th_gen_inspect_each.description: 8th/9th-gen business PCs (OptiPlex/EliteDesk/ThinkCentre) from corporate lease returns, completed with RAM/SSD, inspected before purchase.

basis.resale_twd: assumed haircut of an observed ask: market_comps shows a refurbished i5-8500/16G/512G listing asking NT$7,200 with 68 sold; NT$5,000 assumes a weaker spec/brand. NOT a realized price
basis.completion_parts_twd: assumed (RAM + SSD upgrade); replace with a real parts quote
basis.assumed_bid_twd: placeholder to show EV; the useful output is max_bid
basis.stage p_pass: assumed; lease-return units are better kept than scrap

working_claimed_acer.description: Handoff counterfactual: buy a working-claimed Acer TC-865 (i5-8400) at NT$2,800, verify, resell at NT$5,000. Online purchase: cannot inspect first.

basis.stage p_pass: assumed: 'arrives as described' 0.92 stands in for the handoff's 0.80 overall
